causal_and_economic_hypothesis: Asset Manager/Institutional futures positioning is a buy-side institutional flow proxy. Published Bitcoin-futures evidence characterizes asset managers as contrarian rather than momentum traders. A weekly contraction in their net percentage of open interest therefore defines a positive contrarian score and may identify subsequent recovery conditions in which the existing long-only DRA trend-confirmed entry signal is less likely to be a false admission. The factor is only an admission veto; the parent signal, capital, exits and accounting remain unchanged.

frozen_gates.predictive: Reuse all Design and Validation breadth, sign, concentration and one-sided sign-test gates from BTC_DRA_CFTC_TFF_HISTORICAL_ENTRY_ADMISSION_GATES_V1 after orienting factor_score so positive means the preregistered contrarian direction.
frozen_gates.economic: Reuse all matched-capital Design, Validation, realized/unrealized/total PnL, drawdown, underwater duration, holding, terminal inventory, annual breadth and concentration gates from BTC_DRA_CFTC_TFF_HISTORICAL_ENTRY_ADMISSION_GATES_V1.
frozen_gates.candidate_rule: Every predictive and economic gate must pass before one independent sealed OOS may be considered. Otherwise permanently close this exact family without tuning.

independence_and_deduplication.distinct_from_closed_leveraged_money_fam: Different CFTC participant category and literature-preregistered contrarian direction. The closed family used Leveraged Money net-percent-of-open-interest weekly-delta continuation.
independence_and_deduplication.known_overlap_risk: Both families share the same weekly TFF source, release policy, BTC parent and observation clock; this is not an independent data source and must not be marketed as one.
independence_and_deduplication.pre_outcome_redundancy_disposition: Allowed as a separate participant-behavior mechanism; no leveraged-money threshold, inversion, rerun or reopening is performed.
